input.command:
curl -sL "https://trailhead.salesforce.com/content/learn/modules/javascript-developer-certification-maintenance-summer-25/put-html-class-binding-into-practice" -o /tmp/th.html && python3 -c "
import re, html, json
with open('/tmp/th.html') as f: c=f.read()
# try find challenge instructions in JSON/LD or script
for m in re.finditer(r'challenge|Challenge|computedClass|objectApiName|Account|Opportunity|slds-theme', c):
    start=max(0,m.start()-100); end=min(len(c), m.end()+200)
    # skip if mostly js
    snip=c[start:end]
    if 'function' in snip[:50]: continue
print('LEN', len(c))
# extract text-ish
text=re.sub(r'<script[^>]*>.*?</script>','',c,flags=re.S|re.I)
text=re.sub(r'<style[^>]*>.*?</style>','',text,flags=re.S|re.I)
text=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','\n',text)
text=html.unescape(text)
lines=[l.strip() for l in text.splitlines() if l.strip()]
# print around Challenge
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if re.search(r'challenge|computedClass|objectApiName|Hello, World|Modify|Account|Opportunity|Verify', l, re.I):
        print(f'{i}: {l[:200]}')
" 2>&1 | head -100
